scripts.//test:emulator: Two passes, run by `npm run test:emulator` (`sabeel-ci test-emulator`) against DIFFERENT emulator sets. The RULES pass has no Functions emulator: its tests use clearFirestore, whose mass-deletes would otherwise fire onCardDeleted and race a reused card id; it also rehearses the board-ownership migration scripts end to end (scripts/migration-e2e.mjs), first, on an empty project, with no triggers adding writes. The FUNCTIONS pass runs the triggers and callables. New rules-style tests: add to :rules. New trigger/callable tests: add to :functions (they fail fast in :rules without a functions runtime). Bounded --retry absorbs transient emulator hiccups; a real failure still fails all attempts. Unit tests stay strict.
scripts.test:emulator:rules: node ../scripts/migration-e2e.mjs && vitest run test/integration/cardRules.test.ts test/integration/boardRules.test.ts test/integration/commentRules.test.ts test/integration/attachmentRules.test.ts test/integration/labelRules.test.ts test/integration/statsRules.test.ts test/integration/rules.test.ts test/integration/configRules.test.ts test/integration/concurrentMoves.test.ts --no-file-parallelism --retry=2
scripts.test:emulator:functions: vitest run test/integration/authTrigger.test.ts test/integration/accountExists.test.ts test/integration/signUpGate.test.ts test/integration/setUserAccess.test.ts test/integration/cardTriggers.test.ts test/integration/attachments.test.ts test/integration/labels.test.ts test/integration/boardCardCount.test.ts test/integration/notifications.test.ts test/integration/notificationSweep.test.ts test/integration/stats.test.ts test/integration/lastActivity.test.ts test/integration/boardOwnership.test.ts test/integration/health.test.ts test/integration/acceptRules.test.ts test/integration/reports.test.ts --no-file-parallelism --retry=2
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
